## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A mocked paid post that returns a truncated body without substack.sid and...

The system SHALL ensure that a mocked paid post that returns a truncated body without substack.sid and the full body with it is ingested in full when the cookie is configured.

#### Scenario: A mocked paid post that returns a truncated body without substack.sid and...

WHEN `authenticate-substack-post-fetches-with-the-session-cookie` is implemented
THEN A mocked paid post that returns a truncated body without substack.sid and the full body with it is ingested in full when the cookie is configured.

### Requirement: No request on the post-fetch path is sent without the live cookie when one...

The system SHALL ensure that no request on the post-fetch path is sent without the live cookie when one is configured, and no log line or exception contains the cookie value.

#### Scenario: No request on the post-fetch path is sent without the live cookie when one...

WHEN `authenticate-substack-post-fetches-with-the-session-cookie` is implemented
THEN No request on the post-fetch path is sent without the live cookie when one is configured, and no log line or exception contains the cookie value.

### Requirement: A Substack run with no configured cookie returns zero rows with readiness...

The system SHALL ensure that a Substack run with no configured cookie returns zero rows with readiness code credentials_missing.

#### Scenario: A Substack run with no configured cookie returns zero rows with readiness...

WHEN `authenticate-substack-post-fetches-with-the-session-cookie` is implemented
THEN A Substack run with no configured cookie returns zero rows with readiness code credentials_missing.

### Requirement: A previously ingested teaser row for a paid post is updated to the full body...

The system SHALL ensure that a previously ingested teaser row for a paid post is updated to the full body on the next authenticated run.

#### Scenario: A previously ingested teaser row for a paid post is updated to the full body...

WHEN `authenticate-substack-post-fetches-with-the-session-cookie` is implemented
THEN A previously ingested teaser row for a paid post is updated to the full body on the next authenticated run.
